arguments.value: This agreement is between Marv Enterprises, LLC; Premier Biomedical, Inc.; and Technology Health, Inc. It gives THI exclusive worldwide rights to certain patents and patent applications owned by Marv for COVID-19 treatment-related products and methods, replacing or extending prior licensing arrangements involving Premier. THI must pay Marv an upfront $20,000 already paid, cover about $80,000 in past unpaid invoices by July 20, 2020, reimburse patent and other IP prosecution costs, and pay Marv a 5% royalty on sales or use of licensed products and related services. THI also must pay an additional 5% royalty to certain Premier shareholders until $40 million has been paid. The agreement also says Premier and THI will cooperate on a joint venture to develop COVID-19 treatment products, with THI funding specified development payments, while Marv has no direct role except possible consultation. If required payments are missed, the license can revert to Premier or Marv depending on the missed obligation. The agreement does not state a fixed term or duration. It is governed by Pennsylvania law, with venue in Mercer County, Pennsylvania. It also includes confidentiality, no brokerage fee, and reimbursement of Marv’s legal expenses by THI.
